LanguageData.PhobosRadar_Roofed: Under a roof: it sees nothing. A radar needs open sky over all of it.
LanguageData.PhobosRadar_Inspect: {BAND} radar, antenna {HEIGHT} m up. Sees a fighter at height to {FIGHTER} km, a ten-pod drop to {DROP} km.
LanguageData.PhobosRadar_ScopeViewDesc: Look at the radar picture: what the colony's radars see in the sky around it, and over the colony itself. Colonists keep watch from a radar console.
LanguageData.PhobosRadar_ConsoleInspect: Radars watching: {RADARS} here, {LINKED} by data link from other colonies.
LanguageData.PhobosRadar_ScopeDesc: Open the radar scope: every contact the colony's radars see, unknown, friend or hostile, with its bearing, range and height. While anything is still unknown, a colonist on radar watch sits here and identifies it sooner.
LanguageData.PhobosRadar_ScopeRadars: Radars watching: {OWN} here, {LINKED} by data link.
LanguageData.PhobosRadar_ScopeNoWatch: Nobody on watch: unknown contacts take longer to identify.
LanguageData.PhobosRadar_ScopeNoRadar: No radar is watching: build a radar station under open sky and give it power, or link one from another colony with the data link.
LanguageData.PhobosRadar_WarningText: {RADAR} has contacts coming in towards {COLONY}: {COUNT} {KIND}, from the {BEARING}, about {TIME} out.\n\nWho they are is not known yet. Someone on radar watch at a console will make them out sooner.
LanguageData.PhobosRadar_IdentifiedText: The contacts coming in towards {COLONY} are {FACTION}: {COUNT}, from the {BEARING}, about {TIME} out.
LanguageData.PhobosRadar_InboundText: The radars at {COLONY} see a {WHAT} in flight towards your lands, from the {BEARING}, {KM} km out.
LanguageData.PhobosRadar_AlertInboundDesc: Your radars see contacts coming in:
LanguageData.PhobosRadar_AlertRoofedDesc: A radar station sees nothing while any roof is over it. Remove the roof, or build it in the open.
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingRadarHoldsRaids: Radar warns of drop and air raids
LanguageData.PhobosRadio_SettingRadarHoldsRaidsDesc: When a radar sees a drop-pod or air raid coming, the raid arrives later, by how far out the radar saw it, and a letter warns of it. Raids that walk in are not held. Off, raids arrive as usual and the radars still show what they see.
